We used this model to study How Dexamethasone affects tryptophan metabolism profiles over time in both HIV-positive and HIV-negative TBM patients
Variables are used in this analysis include: evedeath, ttdeath, treatment, and HIV

```{r}
setwd("/home/ubuntu/tb_volume/hanhnlm/metabolomics/")
list.dirs(".")
print(load("./deriveddata/Abundance_JMInput_April2026.RData"))
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(nlme, survival, JM, JMbayes2)
set.seed(1234)
```

- We allow the interaction term in the longitudinal sub-model of the joint modeling, in the fixed effect part. The interaction term could also be specified in the random effect part (which is not used in our current approach).
- When the interaction is include, the main effect coefficient beta1, beta2 for 2 variables day, treatment were interpreted as the association of that variable with outcome only when the other interacting variable is zero.
- Interaction term interpretation: The effect of X1 on Y is expressed as beta1 + beta3. Thus, the slope of X1 is moderated by X2.
- The unexplained variation is represented by the residual error in the equation: error at the individual observation level, measurement error or within subject fluctuation.
- MCMC parameters: n_chains stand for number of parallel MCMC chains (how many indepedent Markov chains are run) -- This matters to the MCMC process cause more chains means better assessment of convergenece, allowing for the calculation of Gelman-Rubin R-hat, this parameter does not change posterior mean much, greatly affects trustworthiness of estimates

```{r hiv-positive TBM}
n_iter <- 15000L; n_burnin <- 10000L; n_thin <- 5L; n_chains <- 20
metabolites <- c(
  "Tryptophan", "Nicotinamide", "5-HIAA",
  "5-HydroxyTryptamine", "Kynurenine",
  "AntranilicAcid", "5-HydroxyTryptophol",
  "Alanine", "3-IndoleaceticAcid", "KynurenicAcid"
)
dat_long <- jm_abu_inputdata_26$long_data %>% left_join(jm_abu_inputdata_26$surv_data %>% dplyr::select(Subject_id, SEX, AGE, TBMGRADE), by = "Subject_id")
dat_surv <- jm_abu_inputdata_26$surv_data
names(dat_long) <- make.names(names(dat_long))
metabolites_safe <- make.names(metabolites)
names(metabolites_safe) <- metabolites
lme_list <- vector("list", length(metabolites))
names(lme_list) <- metabolites_safe

for (i in seq_along(metabolites)) {
  metab_safe <- metabolites_safe[i]
  
  form <- reformulate(
    termlabels = c("day", "arm", "day:arm", "AGE", "SEX"),
    response = metab_safe
  )
  
  lme_list[[i]] <- lme(
    fixed = form,
    random = ~ 1 + day | Subject_id,
    data = dat_long,
    na.action = na.exclude,
    control = lmeControl(
      msMaxIter = 20,
      opt = "optim",
      returnObject = TRUE
    )
  )
}
#> Sanity check
sapply(lme_list, function(fit) identical(fit$data, lme_list[[1]]$data))
sapply(lme_list, nobs)
sapply(lme_list, function(fit)
  length(unique(getData(fit)$Subject_id))
)
cox_26 <- coxph(Surv(tt_ev_2m, ev_2m) ~ arm + AGE + SEX + TBMGRADE,
                data = dat_surv,
                x = TRUE)
# check fitting equation
long_names <- sapply(lme_list, function(fit)
  all.vars(formula(fit))[1]
)
ff <- lapply(names(lme_list), function(v) {
  as.formula(paste0("~ value(", v, ")"))
})
names(ff) <- names(lme_list)
results_multi_hivpos <- jm(
  cox_26,
  lme_list,
  time_var = "day",
  functional_forms = ff,
  save_random_effects = TRUE,
  n_chains = n_chains,
  n_iter = n_iter,
  n_burnin = n_burnin,
  n_thin = n_thin
)
save(results_multi_hivpos, file = "./deriveddata/MULTIVJM_HIVPOS_CV.RData")
rm(results_multi_hivpos)
gc()
```

With the open-label of Dexamethasone for the group of patient of TT in the HIV-negative TBM cohort, we exclude the TT from analysis, and recheck the balance in covariates

```{r hiv-positive TBM}
library(cobalt)
library(WeightIt)
TT_ids <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$surv_data %>% dplyr::filter(LTA4H == "TT") %>% pull(Subject_id)
valid_ids <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$surv_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(LTA4H != "TT") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Subject_id)
surv_LTA4Hrm <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$surv_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subject_id %in% valid_ids)
long_LTA4Hrm <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$long_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subject_id %in% valid_ids)
bal.tab(arm ~ AGE + SEX + TBMGRADE + LTA4H + CSFWBC + CSFNEU + CSFLYM + CSFPROTEIN,
        data = surv_LTA4Hrm,
        estimand = "ATT", # average treatment effect of the treated
        thresholds = c(m=.05))
W.out <- weightit(arm ~ AGE + SEX + TBMGRADE + LTA4H + CSFWBC + CSFNEU + CSFLYM + CSFPROTEIN,
        data = surv_LTA4Hrm, estimand = "ATT", method = "glm")
bal.tab(
  arm ~ AGE + SEX + TBMGRADE + LTA4H + CSFWBC + CSFNEU + CSFLYM + CSFPROTEIN,
  data = surv_LTA4Hrm,
  weights = W.out$weights,
  estimand = "ATT",
  thresholds = c(m = .05)
)
surv_LTA4Hrm$w_ATT <- W.out$weights
surv_LTA4Hrm$ps <- W.out$ps
ps_dat <- data.frame(
  ps = W.out$ps,
  arm = surv_LTA4Hrm$arm,
  w = W.out$weights
)
p1 <- ggplot(ps_dat, aes(ps)) +
  geom_histogram(
    data = subset(ps_dat, arm == "Dexamethasone"),
    aes(y = after_stat(count)),
    bins = 30, fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_histogram(
    data = subset(ps_dat, arm == "Placebo"),
    aes(y = -after_stat(count)),
    bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # coord_flip() +
  labs(
    y = "Count (mirrored)",
    x = "Propensity Score",
    title = "Propensity Score Overlap Before Weighting"
  ) + theme_bw() + theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold")
  )
p1

p2 <- ggplot(ps_dat, aes(ps, weight = w)) +
  geom_histogram(
    data = subset(ps_dat, arm == "Dexamethasone"),
    aes(y = after_stat(count)),
    bins = 30, fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_histogram(
    data = subset(ps_dat, arm == "Placebo"),
    aes(y = -after_stat(count)),
    bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Weighted Count (mirrored)",
    x = "Propensity Score",
    title = "Propensity Score Overlap AFTER Weighting"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold")
  )
p2
```

```{r add metadata}
id_order <- surv_LTA4Hrm$Subject_id
surv_LTA4Hrm <- surv_LTA4Hrm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Subject_id = factor(Subject_id, levels = id_order))
long_LTA4Hrm <- long_LTA4Hrm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Subject_id = factor(Subject_id, levels = id_order))
jm_abu_inputdata_27$surv_LTA4Hrm <- surv_LTA4Hrm
jm_abu_inputdata_27$long_LTA4Hrm <- long_LTA4Hrm

save(jm_abu_inputdata_27, jm_abu_inputdata_26, file="./deriveddata/Abundance_JMInput_April2026.RData")
```

```{r hiv-positive TBM}
n_iter <- 15000L; n_burnin <- 10000L; n_thin <- 5L; n_chains <- 20
results_multi_hivneg <- list()
dat_long <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$long_LTA4Hrm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    day = as.numeric(day),
    Subject_id = factor(Subject_id),
    arm = factor(arm, levels = c("Placebo", "Dexamethasone"))
  )

surv_dat <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$surv_LTA4Hrm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Subject_id = factor(Subject_id),
    arm = factor(arm, levels = c("Placebo", "Dexamethasone"))
  )

for (metab in metabolites) {
  message("Running metabolite: ", metab)
  
  dat_tmp <- dat_long
  dat_tmp$y <- dat_tmp[[metab]]
  
  lme_27 <- lme(
    y ~ day * arm,
    random = ~ 1 + day | Subject_id,
    data = dat_tmp,
    control = lmeControl(msMaxIter = 20, opt = "optim"),
    na.action = na.omit
  )
  
  cox_fit <- coxph(
    Surv(tt_ev_2m, ev_2m) ~ arm + w_ATT,
    data = surv_dat,
    x = TRUE
  )
  
  jm_27 <- jm(
    Surv_object = cox_fit,
    Mixed_objects = lme_27,
    time_var = "day",
    functional_forms = ~ value(y),
    save_random_effects = TRUE,
    n_iter = n_iter,
    n_burnin = n_burnin,
    n_thin = n_thin,
    n_chains = n_chains,
    cores = 5
  )
  
  results_multi_hivneg[[metab]] <- jm_27
}
save(results_multi_hivneg,file = "./deriveddata/MULTIVJM_HIVNEG1_CV.RData")
rm(results_multi_hivneg)
gc()
```
